name: Active Directory Domain Enumeration
description: Detect AD enumeration via LDAP queries, DSQuery, BloodHound collection

triage: Identify what was probed (admin pages, config files, git repos)
Determine if the probing found anything exploitable
containment: Block the source IP at the WAF/firewall
Enable WAF rate limiting for probing patterns
eradication: Verify no sensitive files are exposed (.env, .git, config)
Review for successful access to admin interfaces
Check for exploitation following the reconnaissance
